metadata.title: Global Health Facilities - Building Footprints (World-way)
metadata.description: Polygon and line geometry dataset of global health facility building footprints extracted from OpenStreetMap ways by the Healthsites.io project. Each feature represents a health facility mapped as a way (building outline) in OpenStreetMap. Provided in Shapefile format (.shp, .dbf, .shx, .prj, .cpg).
